message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: 'Test MATLAB-based tutorials'

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 3 * * WED"
      timezone: "Europe/Berlin"
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - '**/*matlab/**'

jobs:
  test-matlab:
    name: Test MATLAB-based tutorials
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: precice/precice:nightly
    timeout-minutes: 10
    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the tutorials repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          apt-get -qq update
          apt-get -qq install wget
          rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
      - name: Set up MATLAB
        uses: matlab-actions/setup-matlab@v3
        with: 
          release: R2024a
      - name: Get the matlab-bindings repository
        run: |
          git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/precice/matlab-bindings.git
          cd matlab-bindings && git status
      - name: Run compilation script
        uses: matlab-actions/run-command@v3
        with:
          command: "addpath('matlab-bindings'), compile_matlab_bindings_for_precice"
      - name: Get run-matlab-command
        run: |
          wget -O /usr/local/bin/run-matlab-command https://ssd.mathworks.com/supportfiles/ci/run-matlab-command/v2/glnxa64/run-matlab-command
          chmod +x /usr/local/bin/run-matlab-command
      - name: Run resonant-circuit
        working-directory: resonant-circuit
        env:
          LD_PRELOAD: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libstdc++.so.6:/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libgfortran.so.5
        run: |
          sed -i 's%</participant>%<export:vtu directory=\"../precice-exports\" /> </participant>%g' precice-config.xml &&
          cd coil-matlab/ && run-matlab-command "addpath('../../matlab-bindings'), coil" &
          cd capacitor-matlab/ && run-matlab-command "addpath('../../matlab-bindings'), capacitor"
      - name: Archive logs
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: test-matlab-logs
          path: |
            resonant-circuit/*.log
            resonant-circuit/*/*.log
            resonant-circuit/capacitor-matlab/Curves.png
          if-no-files-found: warn
      - name: Archive exports
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: test-matlab-exports
          path: |
            resonant-circuit/precice-exports/*
          if-no-files-found: warn",
  "rationale": "The workflow currently has no job timeout, relying on the default 6-hour limit. Historical runs complete in ~3 minutes. Adding a custom timeout of 10 minutes bounds runaway executions, reducing wasted CI resources on hung jobs, as demonstrated by the P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern and experiment.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]
}
